comparison.objective: Cut a copper tube through using a screw-feed tubing cutter without denting it.
comparison.physical_skill: Alternating cutter rotation, incremental feed adjustment, and offcut handling.
comparison.success_condition: Cut through all around, offcut removed and released for 1 s; excessive feed or >0.3 mm out-of-round latches zero.
comparison.reason: Tests progressive cutting and feed-force discipline, not selective screening of loose materials.
